additional_info.subject: Error description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
On February 23, a client attempted to charge on the Type 2 Connector at 6
:04:57 PM CU TIME, but the recharge remained in status "standby" until 6:40:48 PM CU TIME and no energy was delivered. Right after, t
he client’s cable became stuck in the charger, and the connector went into a “faulted” status. We unlocked the connector on our portal and the client removed the cable, but the status was still "faulted". We then rebooted the charger and the problem was solved.
Can you please check the logs?
Thank you

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480129-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313483122005] Check on logs CRM:00263000482
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0480129.
The ticket was opened for issues to charge AC on charger
Y2/S1 313483122005
on 23.02.2026.
Here is the logs' analysis:
The first attempt happened at 2026-02-23T18:02:31. The session failed because the charger tried to close the AC contactor, but it did not close:
At 2026-02-23T18:03:28 a second attempt failed for the same reason.
Third attempt at 2026-02-23T18:04:51. This time, we also see the error flag: PLC-Error-Flag 'Contactor_QA8_AC_Charging' initial value true  - (contactor did not close 3 consecutive attempts). For some reason, the charger did not unlock the AC socket. From the logs I cannot see the reason why, as the SECC is not producing logs for AC sessions, hence I cannot see which signal was missing in order to unlock the socket.
The outlet remained as Faulted due to the error flag. The status was changed after the reboot.
I will forward this ticket to the regional colleagues, so that they can Investigate onsite  the AC contactor and if required replace the faulty component.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480129-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313483122005] Check on logs CRM:00263000482
additional_info.body:
Buongiorno Rosita,
abbiamo monitorato lo stato del charger, a seguito del primo feedback fornitovi dal collega esperto di HQ.
Il contattore relativo alla presa AC potrebbe a volte non aprirsi collegamente e non permettere la ricarica, anche a caausa di "una richiesta sbagliata" da parte del veicolo.
Successivamente all'episodio segnalato, sono state eseguite ulteriori ricariche, andate a buon fine.
Attualmente non vedendo criticità per cui intervenire in sito o tenere aperto il ticket di riferimento, procederemo con la chiusura.
Qualora il problema dovesse ripresentarsi in modo massivo potrete risegnalare l'errore aprendo un nuovo ticket, e procederemo direttamente ad un analisi in sito.
Buona giornata,
Giuseppe
